mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tb_fproof_alarm ( tag_id INT NOT NULL, plc_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (tag_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tb_fproof_trigger ( folder_id INT NOT NULL, start_tag_id INT NOT NULL, end_tag_id INT NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (folder_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.select: SELECT f.folder_id AS folderId, f.folder_name AS folderName, tr.start_tag_id AS customStartTagId, tr.end_tag_id AS customEndTagId, (SELECT MIN(t.tag_id) FROM tb_alarm_tag t WHERE t.folder_id = f.folder_id AND t.alarm_msg = 'Fool Proof 시작') AS defaultStartTagId, (SELECT MIN(t.tag_id) FROM tb_alarm_tag t WHERE t.folder_id = f.folder_id AND t.alarm_msg = 'Fool Proof 종료') AS defaultEndTagId FROM tb_alarm_folder f LEFT JOIN tb_fproof_trigger tr ON tr.folder_id = f.folder_id ORDER BY CHAR_LENGTH(f.folder_name), f.folder_name
SELECT tag_id AS tagId, folder_id AS folderId, tag_name AS tagName, address AS address, alarm_msg AS alarmMsg, level AS level FROM tb_alarm_tag WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY folder_id ASC, tag_id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT fa.tag_id FROM tb_fproof_alarm fa JOIN tb_alarm_tag t ON t.tag_id = fa.tag_id WHERE t.folder_id = #{value} ORDER BY fa.tag_id ASC
SELECT folder_id FROM tb_alarm_tag WHERE tag_id = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_fproof_trigger (folder_id, start_tag_id, end_tag_id) VALUES (#{folderId}, #{startTagId}, #{endTagId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE start_tag_id = VALUES(start_tag_id), end_tag_id = VALUES(end_tag_id)
mapper.select: SELECT history_id AS historyId, tag_id AS tagId, DATE_FORMAT(occur_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS occurTime FROM tb_alarm_history WHERE tag_id IN #{id} AND occur_time >= #{from} AND occur_time < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY occur_time ASC, history_id ASC
SELECT tag_id AS tagId, DATE_FORMAT(occur_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS occurTime FROM tb_alarm_history WHERE tag_id IN #{id} AND occur_time >= #{from} ORDER BY occur_time ASC, history_id ASC

SELECT h.history_id AS historyId, atag.folder_id AS folderId, atag.tag_name AS tagName, atag.alarm_msg AS alarmMsg, DATE_FORMAT(h.occur_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS occurTime, DATE_FORMAT(h.clear_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS clearTime FROM tb_alarm_history h JOIN tb_alarm_tag atag ON atag.tag_id = h.tag_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_fproof_alarm fa WHERE fa.tag_id = h.tag_id) AND h.occur_time >= #{from} AND h.occur_time <= #{to} ORDER BY h.occur_time ASC, h.history_id ASC

SELECT h.history_id AS historyId, atag.tag_name AS tagName, atag.alarm_msg AS alarmMsg, DATE_FORMAT(h.occur_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS occurTime, DATE_FORMAT(h.clear_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS clearTime FROM tb_alarm_history h JOIN tb_alarm_tag atag ON atag.tag_id = h.tag_id WHERE atag.folder_id = #{folderId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_fproof_alarm fa WHERE fa.tag_id = h.tag_id) AND h.occur_time >= #{start} AND h.occur_time <= #{end} ORDER BY h.occur_time ASC, h.history_id ASC
